permission_policy.configuration_surface: Cline CLI --auto-approve plus CLINE_COMMAND_PERMISSIONS JSON policy

software_lifecycle.lockfile_preflight: parse committed package-lock.json: exact root dependency, registry-only resolved URLs, integrity for every non-link package, no file/git/remote escapes, Cline package wrapper bin mapping, expected Cline optional platform packages
software_lifecycle.update_precondition: installed or partial target-owned CLI software surface; absent fails without side effects
software_lifecycle.absent_update_policy: domain failure: Cline CLI is not installed; use install-cli; zero target or parent artifacts
software_lifecycle.preflight_policy: lstat-no-follow current-user-private target and parent before npm registry/install work
software_lifecycle.transaction_directories: unique private staging plus target-bound cleanup journal for retired managed, backup, and software trees
software_lifecycle.cleanup_pending: valid cleanup-pending state is reported by read-only commands, launch fails closed while it exists, and the next mutating command drains it before active changes
software_lifecycle.partial_state_policy: install rejects any replace path or owned software parent; update may repair safe partial state
software_lifecycle.launch_handoff_policy: monotonic product global.lock and canonical-target O_NOFOLLOW fcntl anchors under fixed system temp per-product/per-UID private root; read-only commands open existing anchors no-create; launch captures and strictly resolves the caller current directory once as the project workspace, binds both child cwd and native --cwd to it, and additionally holds a target-internal O_NOFOLLOW fcntl lock file below a dedicated lock directory through child completion; acquisition product external/canonical external/internal and release internal before canonical external; only the internal lock directory and immutable executable/software artifact directories are temporarily read/execute-only while mutable target, HOME, config, TMP, XDG, runtime, and sandbox directories stay writable; manifest is current before protection; entrypoint and package-wrapper identities plus O_NOFOLLOW SHA-256 byte digests are revalidated immediately before path-based spawn
